en: Worker dies after falling 25 meters from roof in Vienna. The worker had installed a lightning rod on the roof of a building on the Linke Wienzeile when he fell into the depths for reasons that are still unclear.
la: Operarius post 25 metra e tecto Viennae decedit. Virgam fulmen in tecto aedificii in Linke Wienzeile instituerat cum in profundis ob causas adhuc obscuras incidit.
